purpose: Make post-result paper closure deterministic enough that positive, negative, parent-sufficient and merge outcomes can all reach an honest R3 decision without post-hoc story selection.
rules: A top-tier paper does not require a positive ORION win; it requires a stable, important, prospectively tested scientific result with strongest controls and complete negative evidence.
A paper cannot survive as standalone merely because its vocabulary is novel.
If the strongest parent explains the protected result with equal or better quality/resources, use parent contraction rather than rhetorical differentiation.
If decisive external evidence is unavailable, use CANNOT_CHECK rather than simulated review.
The flagship is concluded after specialist papers, not before them.

papers.central_question: Can changed-vocabulary structural donor discovery recover useful remote mature parents while controlling false analogy and native-semantic loss?
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: A rigorous map of when cross-field analogy fails and why semantic fidelity must constrain remote-donor search, provided the benchmark is broad and expert-reproducible.

papers.central_question: Can typed context-relative relations preserve native verdicts and improve downstream scientific decisions across representation/measurement changes?
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: An obstruction result showing why apparently equivalent representations cannot be safely transported without explicit loss/boundary conditions, even if ORION adds no empirical advantage.

papers.central_question: When does an obligation-driven scientific controller improve justified terminals versus simple generation, reflection and the strongest parent federation, and when is it drag?
decisive_evidence: at least one naturalistic scientific-domain control
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: A prospectively registered demonstration that elaborate scientific-agent control can reduce executable performance on simple tasks, plus causal component attribution identifying when control is beneficial versus redundant/harmful.

papers.central_question: Can dependence-aware evidence and evaluator-adequacy controls prevent false corroboration/false completion without destroying genuinely independent support?
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: A blinded benchmark demonstrating that multi-agent agreement is not independent evidence and quantifying where mature assurance methods already solve the problem.

papers.central_question: Does prospective opportunity discovery produce later scientific value beyond P-C/F0 and experts?
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: Not standalone; negative evidence strengthens P-C's exploration/problem-finding boundary.

papers.central_question: Can a predeclared machine-native mechanism improve scientific performance under matched compute while retaining external scientific witnesses?
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: No standalone paper unless the negative itself establishes a general matched-compute impossibility/boundary beyond existing parent work.

papers.central_question: Does the explicit knowledge-metabolism lifecycle have causal value beyond simpler composition/control?
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: No standalone paper; preserve the result as a component-contraction finding.

papers.central_question: Is heterogeneous scientific warrant factorisation formally necessary or empirically residual beyond mature assurance/argumentation parents?
Is there a stable higher-order Machine Epistemics residual beyond strongest-parent federation/domain federation across materially different sciences?
decisive_evidence: cross-domain strict gain or principled contraction
papers.top_tier_story_if_negative: A field-demarcation result showing where higher-order unification fails and why parent federation or plural domain science is sufficient, provided the comparison is prospective and externally adjudicated.

portfolio_close_rule: Every paper must end in a positive R3, negative R3, parent contraction, merge/drop, resource/benchmark or explicit CANNOT_CHECK terminal. No manuscript remains open merely because the preferred result failed.
